items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk. It’s a pleasure to meet you.

ctx.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan, and I’m very pleased to have Marty Napoleon with me today, who is a jazz pianist with a long and successful career, and I just learned quite a collector and annotator of your own career too. So welcome.
Thank you, Monk. It’s a pleasure to meet you.
You seem to have a lot of enjoyment in your career in that you’ve saved all this material, and you’re very proud of your travels.
